name: task-assignment-universes-reads-branch-roster
body: task_assignment_universes reads the Agent roster from the branch DB and Components from the layers store, so the drift validation depends on the branch graph holding the Agent nodes. Limit: plan_cmd e2e fixtures that carry no Agent node fail the assigned-to drift check, leaving accepted task-add/update e2e paths red. Upgrade when phase-5 tasks 16-18 land: give those fixtures an Agent definition record so the roster resolves.
